page.layout: One page, a title page. Centred title block in the upper half, a short imprint block in the middle, and a small date line near the lower centre. No running head, no page number, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and blurred. The large central words appear to be the title "PHILOSOPHEMATA", but the letters are mirrored and smeared, probably show-through from the reverse side, so I cannot read the lines with confidence and have not transcribed them.
